question: Which organisation introduced new guidelines in 2025 to regulate the sale of radio equipment, including walkie-talkies, on e-commerce platforms?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA)** was established under the **Consumer Protection Act, 2019**.
 
• Its primary role is to **protect and enforce consumer rights**, prevent unfair trade practices, and ensure no misleading advertisements reach consumers.
